## 1e56158e4892

**Disposition: reproduced distribution shortcut; no source changed.** Generator SHA-256 `d4f0fc8ab1f446262e2af749d4ddf80e55e1dd4711087f9fe1ad4ec788ef2863`; executed rule hash `ac23b1a4ad12`.

The intended rule builds a relation matrix using exact normalized equality and rotation equivalence. The generator chooses a distinct cell count for each latent rotation class (`counts = rng.sample(range(3, 8), n_classes)`). Therefore a cheaper rival is perfect on its emitted domain: diagonal `8`; exact normalized equality `1`; otherwise equal cell count `2`; otherwise `0`.

On 64 deterministic generated inputs—seeds `42000..42063`, sample index `0`, difficulty `None`, no overrides—the rival matched the Racket output **64/64**. All 64 passed `self_check` and the documented 5×23/four-panel/distinct-color domain check. Replay coordinates, per-input hashes, generator/rule hashes, and the supported runner command are in `checks/audit/1e56158e4892/generated64-summary.json`; inputs and authority results are retained beside it.

A separate validator-approved, documented-domain counterexample uses four distinct panel colors: an L tetromino, a rotated L, an unrelated T tetromino with the same four-cell count, and a five-cell shape. Racket correctly labels L-versus-T as `0`; the cell-count rival labels it `2`. The exact matrices and domain/validator checks are in `checks/audit/1e56158e4892/counterexample.json`.

Reproducers from `packet_root`:

```text
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 1e56158e4892 --input ../checks/audit/1e56158e4892/input.json --out ../checks/audit/1e56158e4892/racket.json
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 1e56158e4892 --input ../checks/audit/1e56158e4892/generated64-input.json --out ../checks/audit/1e56158e4892/generated64-racket.json
```

The cheapest repair would generate unrelated classes with overlapping cell counts and add a declared cell-count rival plus an explicit equal-count/different-orbit witness. Until then, the data can reward counting rather than rotation reasoning even though every label is authority-correct.
